purpose: Verify your construction of the witness key-rotation cross-signature offline, without touching any registry. Seeds are fixed (0x11 and 0x22 repeated 32 times) so this file regenerates byte-for-byte.
must_accept: old_sig verifies under old_public_key AND new_sig verifies under new_public_key, both over the exact payload bytes above.
must_refuse: both signatures made by the same key
a signature over a payload with a different witness_id, epoch, old key, or new key
an epoch that is not exactly one greater than the current epoch
not_proven_by_this_file: That a given registry ACCEPTS a correctly constructed rotation. This vector fixes the construction only; the accept path must be exercised against a running registry by whoever owns a witness row.
